⌈

Syntax

)

0x05
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
jobId

Parameters (in)
result
Contains the result of the cryptographic operation.
Parameters (inout)
None

None
Return value

Available via
FrTSyn.h
⌋
[SWS_FrTSyn_00151]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00337, SRS_BSW_00386
⌈The function FrTSyn_IcvGenerationIndication shall inform the Det, if devel-
opment error detection is enabled (FrTSynDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) and if
the function call has failed because of the following reasons:
• jobId is invalid (FRTSYN_E_PARAM)
⌋
